title: Cross-browser compatibility
description: Verify the page loads successfully and remains functional across the three major Playwright browsers: Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. Each browser should be able to load the page without critical errors.
test_case_text: Test cross-browser compatibility: Load the page in three different browsers (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit). For each browser, verify that the page loads correctly, the URL is reachable, and a baseline screenshot can be captured. The page should render consistently across all browsers without blocking errors.
